column1: # Pochven loot (#228, PV-9): what a Triglavian or Drifter wreck in a Pochven
# system holds besides what npc::loot_in gives it. Header in docs/content/schema.md.
# Authored, every rate [A]: no type id, only a type group and a word of the type's
# name. Restart to reload. The Triglavian keys come from the `p` rows of
# pve/filament-drops.tsv, not from here.
# faction: triglavian or drifter (words mapped to the pochven consts), or `off`
#   in this column to turn the whole table off (the world switch).
# class: the NPC's class word from npc/types.tsv (case-insensitive), or `*`.
# group: a type group id (protocol numbers; never a type id).
# name_has: `*`, or a word the type's name must contain (case-insensitive); a
#   hit picks one published type of the group the store knows, uniformly.
# chance_ppm: one independent draw per matching row per wreck, parts per million.
# qty_min, qty_max: the quantity, uniform in the range.
# why: the falsifier. A week of Pochven runs giving far more or far less than the
#   closed economy's sink for these items (eve-mod-econ audit).
